Charges Laid in Electric Dirt Bike Crash Amid Rising E-Mobility Hospitalizations

Police have laid charges in connection with a crash involving an electric dirt bike and an SUV in St. Albert. The incident occurred as hospitalizations related to e-mobility devices are reportedly increasing. RCMP stated that electric dirt bikes are high-speed, off-highway vehicles intended for use in rural areas, not on municipal streets. A teenager has been charged in relation to the collision.
